summary: Plan v6 (07_canonical-witness-truth-lemma.md) Phases 1-6 remain COMPLETED sorry-free. This dispatch was scoped to the two 4-rule cases only (box-positive T(box phi)@w, diamond-negative F(diamond phi)@w) of Phase 7's bespoke S4-keyed step-preservation lemma, per explicit dispatch instructions excluding the mint-blocked case. Both landed sorry-free as standalone case-scoped lemmas in FrameCompleteness.lean: modalApplyOneS4Keyed_boxPos_sat and modalApplyOneS4Keyed_diaNeg_sat, backed by new modalApplyOneS4Rules_boxPos_soundIn/_diaNeg_soundIn (K+T+4 RuleResultSat merge, reusing the already-landed modalApplyOneT_boxPos_soundIn/_diaNeg_soundIn as a black box for K+T and adding the 4-rule propagation layer via one hop of IsTrans). Discovered that most of the .fst/bridge infrastructure this case needed already existed PRIVATELY in LoopChecking.lean (modalApplyOneS4Rules_boxPos_fst/_diaNeg_fst, modalApplyOneS4Keyed_boxPos_eq_S4Rules/_diaNeg_eq_S4Rules), apparently authored in an earlier phase but never wired to FrameCompleteness.lean; de-privatized exactly those (plus two small transitively-needed .snd facts) rather than re-deriving from scratch as the prior dispatch's catalogue suggested, substantially cheaper than expected. All four new declarations verified sorry-free via direct #print axioms ({propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} only, no sorryAx). Sorry census over Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/ unchanged at exactly 1 (the standing, explicitly-retained FrameSoundness.lean:1251). Whole-project lake build clean; lake exe checkInitImports clean; lake lint clean on both touched files (verified against a full-repo run, filtered); lake exe lint-style clean. Four of the five case-split arms are now landed. Phase 7 stays IN PROGRESS -- it is NOT marked COMPLETED, because the fifth case (mint-blocked/redirect) remains open and single-handedly blocks assembling the complete dispatcher theorem: the step lemma cannot typecheck as a total function over all cases until that one closes or the architecture changes. That case was explicitly out of scope for this dispatch and was not re-attempted; the architectural dead-end analysis from the prior dispatch (branchSatisfiableIn_s4FC_addEdge_of_blocked requires full-branch modalHintikkaSetS4 saturation not available at an arbitrary settled step; the extend-ambient-model alternative also fails since blockingWorldS4Keyed's redirect target has no a priori semantic tie to an arbitrary model) is carried forward unchanged and still stands. Dispatcher-theorem assembly, regression corpus extension, and the remaining CI steps (lake test, lake shake, lake exe mk_all --module) are all deferred to phase close, once mint-blocked resolves.
blockers: Mint-blocked (redirect) case of the bespoke S4-keyed step-preservation lemma has no known closing route with currently-available invariants (S4LoopInv, S4KeyedHintikkaInv, plain branchSatisfiableIn s4FC). The previously-catalogued route via branchSatisfiableIn_s4FC_addEdge_of_blocked requires full-branch modalHintikkaSetS4 saturation not available at an arbitrary settled step. The alternative extend-ambient-model route also fails since blockingWorldS4Keyed's redirect target is chosen by a purely syntactic key-subset comparison with no a priori semantic tie to an arbitrary model satisfying the branch. Needs either a stronger per-step invariant threaded through the whole induction, or a rethought decomposition -- recommend raising this at planning level (a plan revision or targeted research dispatch) rather than another blind implementation attempt. This is now the SOLE remaining blocker on Phase 7's completion: four of five case-split arms are landed sorry-free.
